1.title: Inside the Rushed Effort to Get Trump His New Air Force One
1.summary: A New York Times investigation found that President Trump’s push to speed delivery of the aircraft led to ballooning costs and trade-offs in safety features.

2.title: After Democratic Shake-Up, Susan Collins Holds Enormous Cash Edge in Maine
2.summary: Republicans are pouring huge sums behind the Maine senator through a web of billionaire-funded super PACs. Troy Jackson, picked as the new Democratic nominee, has a lot of catching up to do.

3.title: Military Families Express Outrage After Pentagon Lowers Number of U.S. Troop Deaths in Iran War
3.summary: The change in the number to 14 from 18 this week has prompted scrutiny over the Defense Department’s accounting and reporting practices.

4.title: Live Updates: Hundreds of Thousands Flee as Fires Rage in Spain and France
4.summary: Firefighters were racing to contain blazes that were moving closer to Madrid and Bordeaux.

5.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. Strikes Abate, Even as Trump Considers Escalation
5.summary: U.S. forces did not announce new overnight attacks on southern Iran for the first time in about two weeks, but tensions remained high as the Houthis and Saudi-led forces in Yemen said they had traded strikes.

6.title: Wildfire Smoke Chokes Skies in Spain and France
6.summary: Hundreds of thousands of people, including residents as well as vacationers, were forced to evacuate or told to remain indoors.
